title: Typesetters in the '80s - Computerphile
summary: Professor Brailsford of the University of Nottingham describes how the university set out to print its own mathematics exam papers in the 1980s. The story centers on getting a Mergenthaler Linotron 202 typesetter to work with their own software.
why: HN commenters point to it as the history of phototypesetters and a story about the freedom to control your own hardware.

quote.text: explained the brilliant and exiting history of this paper and its recreation, as well as the history of Phototypesetters.
